candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors; order /v1/orders p95 is ~2406ms, indicating downstream latency/timeout at the order dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order metrics show 502s on /v1/orders and postgres save_order activity; the exact failing downstream (postgres vs inventory/payment) is not isolated by current evidence.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s align with transport errors calling order; order /v1/orders p95 ~2406ms matches the ~2s gateway failures, consistent with downstream latency. Order's own downstream cause is not yet isolated.
